label: Mint instance token
description: Mint a token a browser or extension uses to act inside one instance only: start its runs (`Weft-Instance-Token` header on a live route), answer its waits, show its displays, connect its accounts. It always expires, and its value is output once, as a secret.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: expiresInHours
inputs.description: Lifetime in hours, from one second to a year, rounded to the nearest second.

outputs.name: token
outputs.description: The token, as a secret: the run's record holds its marker, never its value. A Reply or a Stream sends it to the browser revealed.
